General-content county map showing buildings in rural areas and householders' names.

General-content county map showing buildings in rural areas and householders' names. Hand col. to show township/borough boundaries and territories. Title devised by cataloguer. LC copy imperfect: Use-worn, shellacked, sectioned to 9 panels to enable folding, torn at fold lines, outer portions of original sheet trimmed off (title, tables, directories, statement of attribution, insets?), extensively annotated in black ink handwriting to give map scale/additional place-names/iron-ore deposit sites, extensively annotated in red/green pencils to show unidentified (glacial?) areas. Includes portion of "Lawrenceville" business directory and portion of table of "Population of Tioga Co. from the census of 1860". Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image.
